mapper.insert: INSERT INTO im_direct_message (user_low_id, user_high_id, sender_id, recipient_id, client_msg_id, body) VALUES (#{low}, #{high}, #{senderId}, #{recipientId}, #{clientMsgId}, #{body}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = LAST_INSERT_ID(id)
INSERT INTO im_direct_pair_lock (user_low_id, user_high_id) VALUES (#{low}, #{high}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE user_low_id = user_low_id
mapper.select: SELECT 1 FROM im_direct_pair_lock WHERE user_low_id = #{low} AND user_high_id = #{high} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO im_direct_inbox (user_id, peer_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{peerId})
mapper.select: SELECT id, sender_id, recipient_id, client_msg_id, body, created_at, recalled_at FROM im_direct_message WHERE sender_id = #{senderId} AND client_msg_id = #{clientMsgId}
SELECT id, sender_id, recipient_id, client_msg_id, body, created_at, recalled_at FROM im_direct_message WHERE id = #{messageId}
mapper.update: UPDATE im_direct_message SET body = '', recalled_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{messageId} AND sender_id = #{senderId} AND recalled_at IS NULL AND created_at >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) - INTERVAL 2 MINUTE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO im_direct_recall (message_id, user_low_id, user_high_id) VALUES (#{messageId}, #{low}, #{high})
mapper.select: SELECT i.peer_id, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM im_direct_message m FORCE INDEX (idx_direct_unread) WHERE m.recipient_id = i.user_id AND m.sender_id = i.peer_id AND m.recalled_at IS NULL AND m.id > COALESCE(r.last_read_message_id, 0)) AS unread_count FROM im_direct_inbox i LEFT JOIN im_direct_read r ON r.user_id = i.user_id AND r.peer_id = i.peer_id WHERE i.user_id = #{userId} HAVING unread_count > 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM im_direct_message WHERE id = #{messageId} AND recipient_id = #{userId} AND sender_id = #{peerId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO im_direct_read (user_id, peer_id, last_read_message_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{peerId}, #{messageId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE last_read_message_id = GREATEST(last_read_message_id, #{messageId})
